HORSES & CARE

Buying & selling horses

Where horse trading fits into the town and what to check before expanding.

Official-source overviewReviewed Nov 6, 2026
THE QUICK ANSWER

The publisher confirms that you can buy and sell horses in the town of Hoofprint Bay. The precise shop navigation, prices, and transaction restrictions still need release-version verification.

Head to town#

The town is a hub for horse trading as well as tack, feed, and competitions. Look for the horse sales location in your game’s town screen. The launch article includes a screenshot of the horse sales interface, but does not document a complete sequence of buttons.

Before buying#

As a planning checklist, review the horse information displayed by the game, check your balance, and inspect your yard’s available space. These checks help you decide whether a purchase fits your goals; they do not establish a verified list of purchase restrictions.

Before selling#

Consider whether the horse is part of your competition or breeding plans before confirming a sale. This wiki has not verified whether sold horses can be bought back. Do not assume that a transaction is reversible.

What still needs verification

Research note

Shop labels, horse availability, sale values, refresh behavior, and capacity checks remain unverified.

This page reflects official descriptions reviewed on November 6, 2026. It has not been verified against a specific playable build. Suggestions are editorial guidance, not tested outcomes.

Frequently asked questions

Where are horses traded?+

In town, according to the publisher’s launch article.

How much does a horse cost?+

A reliable price table has not been verified for this wiki. Check the current offer in your game.

Is a second horse required immediately?+

This wiki has not verified a mandatory early purchase sequence. Follow the goals shown in your game.
